Hi Sarah — thanks again for a great discovery call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- What we heard: Tempest wants a predictable inference stack for in-store personalization (low 50–100ms p99, on-prem possible later), data residency questions, and clear cost projections for 10M requests/month.
- Our ask: an exec alignment (VP/CTO) to greenlight a short pilot and a follow-on technical deep-dive to map integration points.

Proposed schedule: 
1) Exec alignment (VP/CTO intro) — 30m — goals: confirm pilot scope, risk owners, and procurement path
2) Technical deep-dive — 60m — goals: data flows, auth/SSO, infra constraints, sample latency expectations

I can do the following slots (PT): Tue 2/23 10:00–11:00, Wed 2/24 09:00–10:30, Thu 2/25 11:00–12:30. If you prefer, propose Elena's availability and I will loop in Marissa (our solutions engineer) for the tech session.

Attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP_v1.pdf) that maps milestones and timelines — feel free to redline. Also attached the NDA you requested previously (NDA_signed.pdf).

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this moving.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
